description: This file defines a Blazor component named ToastComponent, which provides toast notification functionality in a web application. It manages showing and hiding toasts with different severity levels (Info, Success, Warning, Error) and updates the UI accordingly based on a ToastService's events.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: A Blazor component for displaying toast notifications with different styles based on the message level.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for showing and hiding toast messages when the component initializes.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Callback to display a toast message with specified level and content.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Callback to hide the toast message.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Configures the visual style and heading of the toast based on its level.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Removes event handlers to prevent memory leaks when the component is disposed.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Initializes event subscriptions for toast show/hide.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Handles displaying the toast with given message and level.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Sets toast styles based on the severity level.
